PetMassage™ Training and Research Institute helps students create careers and businesses working with dogs. PetMassage™ is a well-respected pioneer in the canine massage and body work industry. Since 1997, we have held hundreds of workshops and helped thousands of students learn the art of dog massage.

Located in Toledo, Ohio, we specialize in hands-on, on-site workshops because we believe that one-on-one instruction is essential for success in a hands-on trade. Having an experienced professional demonstrate techniques with students before even interacting with dogs, helps students learn correctly.

Find out more at https://petmassage.com
